title: Epigrams of the Milan papyrus (P.Mil.Vogl. VIII 309, 'New Posidippus'); «Миланский папирус» Посидиппа
author: Posidippus of Pella (attribution of all poems debated)
genre: Epigram book in sections (Lithika, Oionoskopika, Hippika, etc.)
edition: Bastianini–Gallazzi 2001; Austin–Bastianini 2002. Modern texts under rights; reuse needs checking.
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Посидипп' lists no Russian translation of the papyrus, only a 2019 study. Russian work so far is analytical (Kazanskaya, Philologia Classica 2016; Hyperboreus 2019).
en_evidence: Austin–Bastianini 2002; Nisetich in Gutzwiller (ed.), The New Posidippus 2005; Fain 2019 chapter (doi 10.1525/9780520947764-006).
value: The only surviving Hellenistic poetry book transmitted on papyrus. It reshaped our picture of Hellenistic epigram and Ptolemaic court ideology (gems, omens, chariot victories). Essential for Hellenistic studies.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Damaged papyrus and supplements need careful marking.
